title: Set-Based Value Function Characterization and Neural Approximation of Stabilization Domains for Input-Constrained Discrete-Time Systems
summary: Analyzing nonlinear systems with stabilizable controlled invariant sets (CISs) requires accurate estimation of their domains of stabilization (DOS) together with associated stabilizing controllers. Despite extensive research, estimating DOSs for general nonlinear systems remains challenging due to fundamental theoretical and computational limitations. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for estimating DOSs for controlled input-constrained discrete-time systems.
